assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original horizontal background artwork for the SAMPATI software workspace, not a UI mockup.
Input image 1 is a DRAWING-STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: borrow its old Indian folk-art feeling, fine ink outlines, flat hand-painted pigments, lyrical feathers and small ornament. Invent an entirely new subject and composition.
Subject: Sampati as a single majestic mythic eagle/vulture with a strong hooked beak, soaring in side view, curved outstretched wings with graceful layered feathers. No people or deity figures.
Composition: very wide landscape approximately 3:1. The entire bird is visible in the RIGHT 45 percent of the frame, head pointing left, one sweeping wing rising; left 55 percent is almost empty dark charcoal negative space, designed to hold readable software headings. Sparse stylised manuscript cloud curls close to the bird and lower right edge, not across the empty left.
Palette: near-black and charcoal #101013 ground, ivory feather highlights, deep crimson red #b72e48 wing plumage, small muted saffron-gold #d6a05a details. Restrained, atmospheric contrast on the background but a distinct recognizable bird silhouette. Match the reference's organic, hand-drawn charm and flat pigments; subtle aged painted texture, no literal antique paper border.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logo lockup, no watermark, no interface, no humans, no weapons, no aircraft, no military or national insignia, no green background. No photorealism, 3D, neon, glowing VFX or glossy digital fantasy. Premium original folk illustration with enough broad shapes to remain attractive in a short panoramic header.

assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / illustration-story.
Asset: ONE final isolated SAMPATI bird logo emblem in the OLD INDIAN FOLK PAINTING STYLE, genuine transparent background. The user rejected a simplified modern vector-like logo and explicitly wants the old folk-art style preserved. This is a pictorial painted emblem, not a minimalist corporate icon.
Reference image 1: the older app bird emblem, for its compact soaring-bird composition and hand-inked curves.
Reference image 2: the approved bird panorama, the PRIMARY authority for the drawing style, feather ornament, pigment and expressive Indian manuscript/folk miniature character. Bring that traditional character into the small emblem.
Draw a beautiful original mythic Sampati eagle/vulture, head facing left, graceful long hooked saffron-gold beak, almond-shaped watchful eye drawn with dark brown calligraphic ink, small swept-back head plumes. The body is ivory, with delicate individually inked neck feathers. One broad wing sweeps UP on the right with long elegant separated feather tips; the other crimson wing curves down and forward beneath the body. Short three-feather ivory tail sweeps toward the lower right. Keep the silhouette compact and balanced in a square, the head prominent and entire bird visible.
The wings have real layered feather rows, crimson-red outer flight feathers, ivory inner feathers, fine muted saffron-gold edges, a few tiny gold dots and petal details borrowed from the panorama. Use organic hand-drawn ink contours with subtle variation in stroke, flat hand-painted warm pigments and gentle aged paint texture WITHIN the feather shapes. The bird should look like a carefully painted detail from an old Indian illustrated manuscript. It must share the visual soul of the reference painting. About 7-9 main flight feathers in the raised wing, not dozens of microscopic lines.
Palette: rich warm deep crimson red, warm aged ivory, tiny muted saffron/gold details, fine dark brown ink. The bird itself carries all the color. Keep the open spaces between the wings and around the head genuinely transparent with clean cutout contours.
Composition: one centered emblem filling around 88 percent of a square canvas with calm even breathing space. No cropped beak or feather tips. Full transparent background. No scene or paper rectangle.
Do NOT make it modern, geometric, flat-vector, glossy, gradient, 3D, esports, aggressive mascot, corporate phoenix, swan, peacock, or a literal letter S. NO floating feather, clouds, background, frame, circle, shield, crown, text, letters, wordmark, human/deity figures, weapons, aircraft, flags, official insignia, mockups, construction diagrams or brand boards. Only one traditional hand-painted bird emblem.
assets.direction: User rejected modern simplification; retain old Indian folk painting style
